newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann says will try to pay 1998 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann says will try to pay 1998 dividend.

text.p: Philipp Holzmann AG management board chairman Lothar Mayer said on Thursday the German construction group would seek to pay a dividend in 1998 but would omit a dividend payout for this year.
Mayer reaffirmed at a company news conference that no dividend would be paid in 1997 but left open the prospect that the Frankfurt-based group would pay one in 1998.
"We will do all we can to be capable of paying dividends in 1998," Mayer told a company news conference.
Mayer also said he would not seek a new employment contract after his current one runs out at the end of 1996.
In addition, Holzmann said its 1996 earnings under German DVFA accounting standards on a per share basis would show a loss of about 60 to 70 marks after a 8.50 mark per share profit in 1995.
Holzmann has been suffering from financial troubles after taking massive write-downs last year on real estate projects.
